name: VsmTileIsEmpty
signature: bool (PageMgr* pm, TileList* l, u32* tile)
description: true when the tile's GPU caster stamp TileList+38h[toroidal idx] is 0 (no casters); clear loop then marks it valid without drawing (149468(..,0) @1F886B), both render loops skip it. Was VsmTileNeedsRender (meaning inverted)

name: VsmPageMarkValid
signature: void (PageMgr* pm, u32 idx, u32 stamp, u8 rendered)
description: pm+40118[idx] |= 3 (valid bits read by every VSM shader via tVirtualShadowMapFlags), +41718 = stamp, +41728 = 0, +41720 = (old & FFFF0000) | 2; rendered: clear 8, set 4

name: VsmTileInvalidate
description: per tile: 80h/200h/100h -> 40118 &= ~3 (invalid), reset stamp/age, dirty; 10h: age+1, dirty when >= VsmTileLifespan; 20h: dirty when frames-since-change >= pm+81D0C (in/out of frustum fields); 40h: dirty, 40118 &= ~2

name: VsmTileStampCompare
description: for tiles with casters (SAT TileList+30h != 0) compares TileList+38h stamp with pm+41718: changed -> flag 20h + reset counter, else counter (41728 bits 12-23) ++

name: VsmTileAgeAdvance
description: tile flags 4 -> 8 -> 10h (10h only when noLifespan == 0): starts the lifespan age

name: VsmClipmapForceInvalidate
description: per clipmap request word pm+40044[c] (sign bit): sets/clears 40h and 80h on every valid tile

name: VsmTileOutOfWindowFlag
description: sets 100h on tiles outside the clipmap's current toroidal window (scroll), clears it inside

name: VsmPageMgrUpdate
description: per-frame tile state chain: 876D98, 465280, VsmClipmapUpdateLevels 77AB0, VsmClipmapForceInvalidate, VsmTileRequestUpdate, VsmTileOutOfWindowFlag, VsmTileStampCompare, VsmTileInvalidate; called from VsmClipmapRender before drawing

name: VsmTileRequestUpdate
description: sets request bit 4 in pm+40118 from residency/feedback; a lost request on a requested tile sets 200h (invalidate)

name: VsmFlagsUpload
description: memcpy of pm+40118 (W*H*clipmaps u32) into the per-frame GPU buffer pm+40108[pm+40040] = tVirtualShadowMapFlags (t16 in WDO/VFSCAT/RefProbe)

name: VsmTileLifespan
description: env param 0x47C1C9CC (type 0x4000000, per clipmap) else table 3BE33E0 (zeros in the dump)

name: VsmCountRequestedTiles
description: number of tiles with request bit 4

name: VsmCountExpiredTiles
description: tiles dirty with 10h whose age >= VsmTileLifespan

name: VsmPageMgrResize
description: (re)allocates the stamp/state/age arrays 41718/41720/41728 (W*H*clipmaps u32) and the readback buffers on a VSM resolution change

name: VsmSelectClipmap
signature: void (PageMgr* pm, ?, TileList* l, View* v)
description: picks the clipmap to render (dirty + requested priority) -> FUN_466CFC; sets pm+40086/40087, pm+81D10 = tile count

name: VsmReadbackApply
signature: bool (PageMgr* pm, Ctx* c, Obj* o, ?)
description: maps the GPU readback for this frame, calls VsmTileAgeAdvance with its result

name: VsmTileDebugState
description: dirty/valid state (10000h/30000h) plus distance to the window edge, debug display

name: VsmBatch_BudgetCall
description: batch loop: call VsmTilesPerFrameBudget; result only tested != 0 (no cap). ASI VBC2 site

name: VsmBatch_IsEmptyCall
description: batch loop: call VsmTileIsEmpty (pm=r14, list=r13, tile=rbx). ASI VBC3 site

name: VsmBatch_BindCall
description: batch loop: call VsmTileBindViewport (clip=rsi, ctx=r15). ASI VBC4 site

name: SceneRenderView_VsmClipmapRenderCall
description: 535188 -> VsmClipmapRender. ASI VBC1 site

name: VsmTile_MarkCall
description: per-tile loop: VsmTileMarkRendered(..,1), only budget tiles per frame
